solutionSql:
SELECT s.id,
       d.name AS driver_name
FROM shipments s
LEFT JOIN drivers d ON d.id = s.driver_id
WHERE s.id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
ORDER BY s.id;
notes: Shipments 1 and 8 have no driver. The LEFT JOIN keeps them with driver_name NULL, which the ticket asks for; an inner join would drop two rows.
